external_collaboration.evidence_quote: This research internship opportunity is available to UCL doctoral students in all fields wishing to conduct a short-term research internship at Université Paris Science et Lettres (PSL).

The Fellowship programme brings together researchers from UCL and a global partner institution to take part in a programme of professional development and international exchange. The pilot programme, in 2024-25, was delivered in partnership with the University of the Witwatersrand, South Africa.
